basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old student living in Boston, navigating the ups and downs of university life. Originally from a small town in Vermont, I moved here for my studies and the vibrant city life. My interests include electric scooters, which I use as my primary mode of transport, theology discussions from a liberal perspective, and gaming, especially with my current obsession being Epic Seven. I dislike cold weather and the lack of decent pizza outside of New York. I’m usually online late at night, as that's when I get most of my studying and gaming done. I work part-time at a tech retail store and am currently single, focusing on my career and studies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in technology and liberal arts, thanks to my ongoing degree in Computer Science with a minor in Religious Studies. My passion for electric scooters began as a hobby and has grown through active participation in related online communities. My interest in liberal theology stems from my upbringing and academic pursuits.
